text:
olivia_product: Heads-up — MacroAI (big ARR, legal already engaged) just asked for feature parity with CompetitorX connectors before our C1 launch. They want: ingest connectors, pre-run indexing, per-tenant reranking. Can we accommodate without blowing the timeline?

raj_eng: Quick take: connectors + indexing is doable but adds ~3 sprint weeks of infra + QA. Reranking per-tenant is trickier (stateful isolation + eval).

anna_pm: Important context: marketing promised 'enterprise-grade connectors' in the C1 deck. If we say no, sales will push for a roadmap commitment.

sara_sales: MacroAI says it's a deal breaker. They will sign if connectors + tenant-level ranking available at launch. Otherwise they go to CompetitorX.

tomas_se: From SE POV, we could ship a v1 connectors adapter (S3, GDrive, DB) and a managed indexing job. Make reranking a toggled opt-in feature for early customers.

emily_research: Concern: enabling per-tenant reranker without offline eval could regress quality. We need eval harness + guardrails, otherwise support cost spike.

raj_eng: Proposal: scope split. Phase A (C1): adapters + managed indexing + single-model global reranker with tenant-weight knobs. Phase B (post-C1): tenant-specific reranker + audits + KV isolation. Phase A cost: ~3w infra + 1w docs + soft launch. Phase B: 4-6w engineering, evals, security review.

olivia_product: That sounds like a compromise. Anna, can we update the launch criteria to list connectors + managed indexing as "must-have" and tenant reranking as "A1 backlog"?

anna_pm: Yes. I'll update the PRD: must-have = adapters + managed index + basic reranker controls; nice-to-have = tenant-specific rerank & audit. Add launch gating: no known regression on sample corpus, infra SLO p95 <= 350ms for generation path.

sara_sales: I'll tell MacroAI that adapters + managed indexing are committed for launch and tenant reranking is in the prioritized backlog with a tentative Q2 timeline. Will that keep them engaged?

tomas_se: Yes, but include a migration plan + interim workaround: customer can upload pre-ranked documents and we expose a small rerank weighting param.

emily_research: Also request permission to run A/B on their traffic for early eval — helps us iterate without full isolation.

raj_eng: Action items: 1) infra: allocate 3w for adapters/indexing (owner: raj_eng). 2) platform: add global reranker knobs (owner: tomas_se). 3) research: eval harness + run A/B (owner: emily_research). 4) PM: update PRD & launch checklist (owner: anna_pm).

olivia_product: Timeline check: can we still hit C1 date with those tasks? If yes, proceed. If not, we need to delay or negotiate with MacroAI.

raj_eng: I'll schedule a quick capacity sync today. If we can pull one engineer from Optimize and one from Runtime, C1 is still realistic.

deploy-bot: Note: rollout freeze scheduled in 5 days for security review window.

anna_pm: Good catch. We'll factor that into the schedule and T-minus planning.

olivia_product: Thanks team. Sara, hold the customer message until I confirm after the capacity sync (ETA EOD).
